realtimes.model: I'm Carlos, from apartment 6. I can play the guitar, but I can't sing. Max, my dog, can't sing… but he sings every day at 6 in the morning! Can Max swim? Yes, he can. Can he dance? No, he can't. How about you? What can you do? Can you play the guitar?

Onde eu posso comprar sapatos rosa? Os meus sapatos são azul-escuros! Posso ir com a jaqueta verde-clara da Jenny? A Jenny fala: Claro que pode!
